entries.en: Horse controls\nWhile riding, use [i2] to accelerate and [i1] to brake sharply.\nThe horse will keep running even when you release [i2], but will gradually slow down.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r0/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When a violent car comes after you...\nIf you find yourself being chased by a runaway car,\ntry escaping past utility poles and streetlights.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r1/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Door indicator lights\nDoors in the research facility have indicator lights beside them.\nBlue means you can pass, red means you cannot, and yellow means access depends on certain conditions.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r2/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Stay calm when attacked...\nFirst, look around and work out where to go next.\nEscaping should be easier than trying to find a route after an attack begins.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r3/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Observation deck, first floor\nTalk to different people and examine your surroundings.\nBesides helping you escape, this will help you get a feel for the layout.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r4/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Avoiding danger\nWatch above you as well as ahead and to the sides as you move.\nThis should help you avoid danger.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r5/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When buildings collapse...\nIf a nearby building starts to collapse, get as far away as you can.\nFalling chunks of debris are extremely dangerous.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r6/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When a violent man chases you...\nStay calm and press [i4] at the right moment to evade danger.\nYou can also escape by sprinting with [i12].
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r7/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Hiding effectively\nWhile your pursuer has their back turned, move to your next hiding place.\nIt also helps to spot possible hiding places ahead of time.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r8/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Ladders\nIf you see a ladder, try climbing it.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r9/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Talk to Yuki\nEven during peaceful moments, try talking to Yuki when you feel like it.\nYou might discover a new side of her.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r10/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When a violent man chases you...\nStay calm and press [i4] at the right moment to evade danger.\nYou can also escape by sprinting with [i12].
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r11/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: If you get stuck...\nTry talking to different people.\nYou might discover a way forward.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r12/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Inside the collapsing restaurant...\nWatch above you as well as underfoot as you move.\nA little caution can help you avoid danger.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r13/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: On the lower levels...\nTake your time exploring your surroundings.\nYou may find a way forward.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r14/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Costume effects\nSome costumes increase the maximum capacity of your health gauge or\nstamina gauge while equipped.

entries.en: Food and drink effects\nSome food and drink items reduce the rate at which stamina\ndecreases for a limited time.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r16/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Stamina\nThe lower gauge at the top left of the screen shows your stamina.\nWhen it runs out, you cannot sprint for a while.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r17/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Sprinting\nHold [i12] while moving to sprint.\nSprinting lets you run faster.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r18/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Changing your hairstyle\nIf you find a mirror, try examining it.\nYou can change your hairstyle.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r19/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Emergency evasion\nIf a ! symbol appears above the protagonist’s head, try pressing [i4].\nYou might be able to escape danger.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r20/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Preventing a fall\nIf you feel yourself about to fall, try pressing [i4].\nYou can prevent yourself from falling.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0060.json:r21/c5; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: If something looks dangerous...\nYou never know what might happen near a giant shadow.\nIt is wise not to approach anything that looks dangerous carelessly.

entries.en: When your hands and feet are tied\nYour actions are limited while you are tied up.\nIt seems you cannot open doors or desks.

entries.en:
I have always thought of you.
We met by chance.
Somewhere along the way, you became so important to me.
But I was frustrated with myself for being unable to say it.
I longed for you, and it hurt. I felt pathetic.
As the day we would have to part drew near,
I finally managed to give you my letter.
I was so happy to receive your reply.
Now I am truly happy.

entries.en: Following the death of her husband, the captain’s wife spoke through tears: “My husband had already reached retirement age. We were supposed to go traveling after he retired, but they were short-staffed, so he agreed to work another six months. He told me this would be his last assignment and that we would finally take that trip. I never imagined something like this would happen...” All we can do is hope that peaceful days return soon.

entries.en: The Japan Coast Guard announced that the research vessel “Shibazakura” rescued people who had been adrift shortly before it sank. According to investigators, the vessel’s captain had contacted the Coast Guard to report rescuing people drifting in a small boat. However, the condition and whereabouts of the two rescued individuals remain unknown.

entries.en: Research Vessel Crew Member Had a History of Shirking Duties

entries.en: “So Precious”: Baby Koala Peeks Out of Its Pouch at Miyato City Zoo

entries.en:
A baby koala born at Miyato City Zoo has poked its head out of its mother’s pouch. Like kangaroos, koalas are marsupials, and their young spend six to seven months developing inside the pouch.
An enthusiastic koala fan from Miyato City spoke excitedly: “Koalas are so precious. I’ve come to the zoo every day since the baby was born. I’m thrilled I finally got to see its face. I think I’ll sleep well tonight.”

entries.en: “I Wish I Could Touch It”: World Gold Exhibition at Miyato City Museum
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0005.json:p0/k139; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The “World Gold Exhibition” is currently being held at Miyato City Museum in the Sumire district.
On display are gold artifacts from around the world. The main attraction is the “Golden Cat,” a pure-gold sculpture so meticulously crafted that it could be mistaken for a real cat. The World Gold Museum had never previously allowed the piece to leave its collection. Visitors commented, “Its fur looks just like a real cat’s. I wish I could touch it. I want to take it home!”

entries.en: “Absolutely Outrageous”: Theft Spikes Amid Miyato City Emergency
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0005.json:p0/k141; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The chaos caused by the giant creatures appearing in Miyato City today has brought a wave of thefts of money and valuables.
The Sakura district, where the first giant alien appeared, has been particularly hard hit. Police have received 20 theft reports.
A man whose business office is in Sakura district had a painting worth approximately 10 million yen stolen while he was temporarily evacuated.
“At a time like this, with an unprecedented disaster unfolding, we should all be helping each other. Stealing from people now is absolutely outrageous. I hope they catch whoever did it,” he said.

entries.en: “We’re on High Alert”: Evacuees Fear Giant Shadows Could Return Without Warning
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0005.json:p0/k143; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Many residents of Miyato City are spending an anxious night in evacuation shelters after today’s giant-shadow incidents.
The giant creatures have already disappeared from some areas, but because they appeared without warning, residents say they are “on high alert in case they suddenly come back.” Others have taken a more resigned view: “If there’s no telling when they’ll show up, there’s no point worrying.” The mood at the shelters remains tense.

entries.en:
Late at night, local police responded to several reports from residents near the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute who said they had heard what sounded like screams coming from inside.
According to the officers who entered the institute, the researchers still inside were all so exhausted that they were in no condition to answer questions.
Police plan to question them again once they have recovered.

entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0151.json:p0/k69; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A person claiming to be a researcher at the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute posted a photograph said to show a “mysterious figure” that appeared late at night. According to the poster, the figure carried a large ray gun, had a striped body, and repeatedly teleported while making a strange cry of “Dah-dah!”

entries.en:
Researchers at the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute have informed management that they intend to suspend their work temporarily in protest over the lack of a shop or convenience store on the premises.
One researcher complained, “It’s awful. You can work up an appetite doing research and still not be able to get so much as a rice ball.”

entries.en: A Storage Room Saved Their Lives
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0151.json:p0/k75; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: It has emerged that two staff members were rescued from a storage room designed to block cosmic rays and electromagnetic radiation. Witness accounts indicate that the mysterious figure could teleport, vanishing from one spot and suddenly appearing in another. For some reason, however, it apparently could not enter the storage room where the two employees had taken refuge. Their narrow escape saved their lives.

entries.en: Investigators are considering the possibility that the mysterious figure who attacked the National Cosmic Ray Research Institute intended to seize control of the facility itself. Internal communications relied entirely on computers, and mobile phones could not be used in rooms that blocked radio waves. A surviving researcher has confirmed that when the server lost power, staff were left without any means of communication.

entries.en:
The National Cosmic Ray Research Institute is a world-renowned center for cutting-edge cosmic-ray research. Brilliant minds from around the globe gather there to conduct advanced investigations and experiments every day.

Yet one thing is hard to understand: the institute does not have a single toilet. Employees have made sarcastic remarks, suggesting either that the deputy director who oversaw construction simply forgot, or that toilets were deprioritized to maximize research space while building right up to the legal site-coverage limit.
Staff must leave the institute and use toilets elsewhere.

entries.en: Flashes of Light Stop—Is the Crisis Over?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0001.json:p0/k81; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: At 7:00 a.m. today, the Japan Meteorological Agency announced that the flashes of light seen in the sky over the past several days had stopped. According to a deputy director at the National Institute for Cosmic Ray Research, matter that had been streaming in from space is no longer being detected. The cause of the sudden cessation remains unknown.

entries.en: Modern Society: A Generation of Exhausted Young People
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0001.json:p0/k83; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The recent crisis has left many people injured and exhausted. Beyond physical harm, many have suffered serious psychological trauma, which some experts say has been particularly pronounced among younger people. Accurate figures have yet to be collected, but addressing these psychological effects is an urgent priority.

entries.en: The red monster’s rampage has ruptured water mains in Sakura Ward, authorities have confirmed. In some areas, water is gushing above ground. The Self-Defense Forces have begun supplying water to areas experiencing outages. There is currently no estimate for when service will be restored.

According to witnesses, she climbed onto a damaged pedestrian overpass and murmured, “Please buy some flowers... Please.”

entries.en: Young Person Pays Three Million Yen for a Single Flower
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0001.json:p0/k105; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
A tip sent to this website reports that a young person left three million yen in payment for a single flower from a street vendor near the Sakuramachi intersection in Sakura Ward.
The vendor had been devastated after her shop was destroyed. The young person handed her the money and walked away.
